mismatch_patterns.explanation: The app initiates persistent background socket communication via an exported Service (SocketService) without any UI indication or user-facing justification. This network activity is not triggered by user actions and is handled entirely in the background, enabling covert command-and-control or data exfiltration. The exported nature of the Service allows remote entities to trigger this behavior, which is a classic mismatch pattern.

SocketService is exported and can be triggered externally, enabling background network communication without user interaction or awareness. This allows remote activation of sensitive functionality, which is a hallmark of mismatch mechanisms.
